input_boundary: Only the already-spent dropout-v4 seeds 13025, 13039, 13043, 13045, 13048, and 13051 were used. No fresh synthetic seed or live playback/capture was consumed.

mechanism.name: efference_masked_mean_30_5
mechanism.rule: For a self-generated structured token, retain only spectral frames whose source samples do not overlap any intentionally erased efference sample, then average the remaining normalized 12-band signatures.

selection_rule: First require four-state occupancy in all vowel conditions, then maximize minimum vowel-condition improvement, then pooled vowel improvement, then tone improvement, then prefer the shorter frame. The 30 ms candidate is selected over the tied 40 ms vowel result by tone improvement.
decision: Advance only the 30 ms mask-aware mechanism to one fresh synthetic seed matrix. Real I/O remains prohibited until that prospective gate passes and a separate real-run preregistration is committed.
claim_boundary: This is positive design evidence on spent synthetic data. The mask is available only for self-generated structured audio with known source erasures. It does not establish live room robustness, arbitrary sensory-dropout detection, or natural-world missing-observation handling.
